title: Implement provider registry in crypto2dev.ko
description:
Create src/provider/crypto2dev_registry.c implementing the provider list with rwlock protection.

Must implement:
- crypto2dev_register_provider(): add to list, pr_warn if algo collision (first-registered wins)
- crypto2dev_unregister_provider(): remove from list safely
- crypto2dev_lookup_algo(algo): walk list, return first ops that matches algo string
- Export all three with EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL
- Thread safety: rwlock (readers for lookup, write lock for register/unregister)

Depends on: WOLFKM issue for provider header
